# Binary flags are readable without decimal conversion; source => value or error:diagnostic.
let flags = 0b1010; flags + 0b0011 => 13
fn mask(x) { x + 0b1 }; mask(0b10) => 3
sum([0b1, 0b10, 0b100]) => 7
0b1_0_1 => 5
-0b101 => -5
match 0b1010 { 0b1010 => 7, _ => 0 } => 7
match -0b10 { -0b10 => 9, _ => 0 } => 9
match 10 { 0b1010 => 1, 10 => 2 } => error:duplicate match pattern
0 && 0b1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111 => 0
1 || -0b1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111 => 1
0b => error:expected integer
0b2 => error:expected integer
0b_1 => error:expected integer
0b1_ => error:expected semicolon
0b1__0 => error:expected semicolon
0 && 0b_1 => error:expected integer
match 0 { 0 => 2, 0b2 => 3 } => error:expected integer
